search.message: Search by name, label or source

scannerHint.message: Original scanner and advanced controls. Site-asset classification is heuristic; all results remain available.

extended.message: Include CSS backgrounds and already-loaded image resources on the next scan

extendedHint.message: Additional candidates appear in Review. Scans also include responsive candidates, open shadow DOM and accessible same-origin frames. No page scrolling or cross-origin access.

tokens.message: Tokens: {n} {name} {ext} {host} {date}. Applying a template changes all matching names.

suffixHint.message: Existing disk files may receive Chrome suffixes. Actual saved paths appear in outcomes.

initial.message: Review the files you want, then download.

firstRun.message: Open a webpage → select images or documents → Download Selected. Results appear below; keep Chrome running.

invalidRegex.message: Invalid regex. Correct it in Options or clear that field.

batchLimit.message: Select 500 files or fewer per batch. Use Select this page for smaller batches.

verifyDocument.message: Document label suggestion — verify before saving

emptyView.message: No files in this view. Try Images, Review, Site assets or All files; nothing was discarded.

emptyPage.message: No HTTP(S) files found. Scroll the webpage to load more images, then scan again.

historyNote.message: $1 of $2 records shown. Completed means Chrome saved the response, not that its content was validated.

unsupported.message: Open an HTTP(S) webpage and click Batch Grab. Chrome system/store pages cannot be scanned.

scanLimited.message: A scan limit was reached. Narrow the source page; some files or page regions were not scanned.

scanHelp.message: Select useful files, then Download Selected. Check Review for uncertain images and use Details & name to edit filenames.

scanDenied.message: Chrome could not scan this page. Try a normal webpage, reload it, and reopen Batch Grab. Your pending downloads remain in Results.

jobsAccepted.message: $1 jobs saved. You can close the popup; keep Chrome running.

noHistory.message: No download history to export yet.

exported.message: Source index requested. It includes original URLs and actual outcomes; keep it private if sources contain tokens.

clearedScan.message: Saved page scan cleared. Click Scan current page to start again.

historyEmpty.message: No downloads yet. Select a file above and choose Download Selected.

evidence20.message: Logo wording in filename or image label

evidence21.message: Icon wording or small SVG dimensions

evidence22.message: Page marks this image as decorative

evidence24.message: Alternative source resolution; dimensions and relevance need review

evidence25.message: Additional image source; relevance and downloadability need review

evidence26.message: Image is in hidden page markup; review its relevance

evidence28.message: Link points to an image file

evidence29.message: Thumbnail wording or linked video card

evidence30.message: Image belongs to a labelled content/product card

evidence31.message: Thumbnail wording without a specific content-card association

evidence33.message: Small image; may still be useful

evidence34.message: Insufficient size or context to classify confidently

extensionDescription.message: Preview and download webpage images and documents. Review filenames, organize folders, and check actual download results.

evidenceError0.message: Select between 1 and 500 files per batch.

evidenceError1.message: Queue limit reached. Wait for current downloads to finish.

evidenceError2.message: Only failed downloads can be retried once per attempt.

evidenceError4.message: Chrome no longer has this download record.

evidenceError5.message: Download start could not be confirmed after worker restart. Check Downloads before retrying.

evidenceError6.message: Invalid or overly long download URL.

evidenceError7.message: Use an HTTP(S) download URL without embedded credentials.

evidenceError8.message: Queue storage limit reached. Clear finished history or use a smaller batch.

evidenceError9.message: Only HTTP and HTTPS downloads are supported.
